svg.desc: Verse Lines generated from all 1151 written words in surah 27.
svg.metadata: {"surah":27,"name":"An-Naml","method":"Verse Lines","words":1151,"letters":4736,"selectedVerse":null,"mapping":"For verse index i starting at 0, L=sum(word lengths); centered endpoints=(-3L,12i),(+3L,12i), so length=6L; uniformly fit all endpoints into [40,560]x[30,450], retaining length ratios; row stroke width=max(.45,min(1.6,.65*12*fitScale)); word boundaries at x=-3L+6*cumulativeWordLength are decorative paper-color breaks of width1 and height(rowStrokeWidth+1.4), drawn only when both neighboring words are at least3 SVG pixels wide; highlight selected verse in copper with width2.5; one verse remains a centered horizontal line","source":"https://api.quran.com/api/v4/quran/verses/uthmani","counting":"Unicode whitespace words; Unicode L letters except U+0640/U+06E5/U+06E6; no normalization"}
